meta.title: Decisiveness
meta.description: The clues are often fleeting and opportunities never knock when you're ready.

units.rawText: A wall of blue that drowns out the sky fills my vision.
units.displayText: A wall of blue that drowns out the sky fills my vision.

spans.text: A wall of blue that drowns out the sky fills my vision.

units.rawText: My body loses the support of the land and I am tossed about by the ocean's currents. Although I don't need to breathe in the cloud server, I'm still filled with an instinctive fear of the abyss before me.
units.displayText: My body loses the support of the land and I am tossed about by the ocean's currents. Although I don't need to breathe in the cloud server, I'm still filled with an instinctive fear of the abyss before me.

spans.text: My body loses the support of the land and I am tossed about by the ocean's currents. Although I don't need to breathe in the cloud server, I'm still filled with an instinctive fear of the abyss before me.

units.rawText: Pro... fessor...
units.displayText: Pro... fessor...

spans.text: Pro... fessor...

units.rawText: A warm hand grabs hold of me.
units.displayText: A warm hand grabs hold of me.

spans.text: A warm hand grabs hold of me.

units.rawText: Water gushes past my ears and the scene before me resolves into clarity.
units.displayText: Water gushes past my ears and the scene before me resolves into clarity.

spans.text: Water gushes past my ears and the scene before me resolves into clarity.

units.rawText: Prof!
units.displayText: Prof!

spans.text: Prof!

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: Don't panic! Don't thrash around! Relax and kick at the water, then move slowly toward me...
units.displayText: Don't panic! Don't thrash around! Relax and kick at the water, then move slowly toward me...

spans.text: Don't panic! Don't thrash around! Relax and kick at the water, then move slowly toward me...

units.rawText: I do as Sol says, slowly moving forward.
units.displayText: I do as Sol says, slowly moving forward.

spans.text: I do as Sol says, slowly moving forward.

units.rawText: Persicaria and Antonina have already joined hands. The four of us form a circle, floating amidst the ocean swells.
units.displayText: Persicaria and Antonina have already joined hands. The four of us form a circle, floating amidst the ocean swells.

spans.text: Persicaria and Antonina have already joined hands. The four of us form a circle, floating amidst the ocean swells.

units.rawText: Everyone, hold on tight to each other and maintain your balance! Then try to think of a way to head towards shore!
units.displayText: Everyone, hold on tight to each other and maintain your balance! Then try to think of a way to head towards shore!

spans.text: Everyone, hold on tight to each other and maintain your balance! Then try to think of a way to head towards shore!

units.rawText: Wait, Sol! Over there!
units.displayText: Wait, Sol! Over there!

spans.text: Wait, Sol! Over there!

units.rawText: It's taking all of Antonina's strength just to keep herself oriented, so she gestures into the distance with her eyes.
units.displayText: It's taking all of Antonina's strength just to keep herself oriented, so she gestures into the distance with her eyes.

spans.text: It's taking all of Antonina's strength just to keep herself oriented, so she gestures into the distance with her eyes.

units.rawText: We follow her gaze. There is a massive vortex amidst the raging tsunami, and seawater is spiraling into its center.
units.displayText: We follow her gaze. There is a massive vortex amidst the raging tsunami, and seawater is spiraling into its center.

spans.text: We follow her gaze. There is a massive vortex amidst the raging tsunami, and seawater is spiraling into its center.

units.rawText: That's the maelstrom at the heart of the tsunami!
units.displayText: That's the maelstrom at the heart of the tsunami!

spans.text: That's the maelstrom at the heart of the tsunami!

units.rawText: Keep away from it, we'll be done for if we get sucked in!
units.displayText: Keep away from it, we'll be done for if we get sucked in!

spans.text: Keep away from it, we'll be done for if we get sucked in!

units.rawText: No! Look at the heart of the vortex!
units.displayText: No! Look at the heart of the vortex!

spans.text: No! Look at the heart of the vortex!

units.rawText: ...Is that... a hole?
units.displayText: ...Is that... a hole?

spans.text: ...Is that... a hole?

units.rawText:
As the seawater is sucked in, the naked sea floor gradually becomes visible to us.
However, the rocks there are not flat like we expected, but jutting out into a yawning maw that hints at a bottomless abyss within.
units.displayText:
As the seawater is sucked in, the naked sea floor gradually becomes visible to us.
However, the rocks there are not flat like we expected, but jutting out into a yawning maw that hints at a bottomless abyss within.

As the seawater is sucked in, the naked sea floor gradually becomes visible to us.
However, the rocks there are not flat like we expected, but jutting out into a yawning maw that hints at a bottomless abyss within.

units.rawText: The bedrock is shifting...
units.displayText: The bedrock is shifting...

spans.text: The bedrock is shifting...

units.rawText: C-calm down, everyone... This must be the result of some kind of tectonic compression...
units.displayText: C-calm down, everyone... This must be the result of some kind of tectonic compression...

spans.text: C-calm down, everyone... This must be the result of some kind of tectonic compression...

units.rawText: Normally, tsunamis generated in a small region like this should be over soon enough, so as long as we maintain...
units.displayText: Normally, tsunamis generated in a small region like this should be over soon enough, so as long as we maintain...

spans.text: Normally, tsunamis generated in a small region like this should be over soon enough, so as long as we maintain...

units.rawText: A surging wave swallows up the rest of Sol's words. The seawater pushes us a good distance away before we have the chance to poke our heads back above water.
units.displayText: A surging wave swallows up the rest of Sol's words. The seawater pushes us a good distance away before we have the chance to poke our heads back above water.

spans.text: A surging wave swallows up the rest of Sol's words. The seawater pushes us a good distance away before we have the chance to poke our heads back above water.

units.rawText: (Coughs) This tsunami happened so fast but it's got so much force behind it... How is that possible...
units.displayText: (Coughs) This tsunami happened so fast but it's got so much force behind it... How is that possible...

spans.text: (Coughs) This tsunami happened so fast but it's got so much force behind it... How is that possible...

units.rawText: Don't try to apply normal logic, Sol! This isn't the real world. Everything is simulated through operands!
units.displayText: Don't try to apply normal logic, Sol! This isn't the real world. Everything is simulated through operands!

spans.text: Don't try to apply normal logic, Sol! This isn't the real world. Everything is simulated through operands!

units.rawText: Another wave's coming! Look out!
units.displayText: Another wave's coming! Look out!

spans.text: Another wave's coming! Look out!

units.rawText: Before Antonina can finish, a massive wave surges toward us.
units.displayText: Before Antonina can finish, a massive wave surges toward us.

spans.text: Before Antonina can finish, a massive wave surges toward us.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: An—
units.displayText: An—

spans.text: An—

units.rawText: Persicaria's voice is drowned out by the wall of sea foam that crashes down on us.
units.displayText: Persicaria's voice is drowned out by the wall of sea foam that crashes down on us.

spans.text: Persicaria's voice is drowned out by the wall of sea foam that crashes down on us.

units.rawText: An endless expanse of seawater fills my line of sight once more and the ice-cold seawater gradually saps my strength. Amidst this chaos, the only thing I can feel is Sol holding on tightly to my hand.
units.displayText: An endless expanse of seawater fills my line of sight once more and the ice-cold seawater gradually saps my strength. Amidst this chaos, the only thing I can feel is Sol holding on tightly to my hand.

spans.text: An endless expanse of seawater fills my line of sight once more and the ice-cold seawater gradually saps my strength. Amidst this chaos, the only thing I can feel is Sol holding on tightly to my hand.

units.rawText: Relax and don't panic! I'll save everyone!
units.displayText: Relax and don't panic! I'll save everyone!

spans.text: Relax and don't panic! I'll save everyone!

units.rawText: Sol wraps her arm around my body and I feel myself rising steadily. It seems Sol has managed to find the right current among all this aquatic turbulence and is steadily taking us away from the heart of the vortex.
units.displayText: Sol wraps her arm around my body and I feel myself rising steadily. It seems Sol has managed to find the right current among all this aquatic turbulence and is steadily taking us away from the heart of the vortex.

spans.text: Sol wraps her arm around my body and I feel myself rising steadily. It seems Sol has managed to find the right current among all this aquatic turbulence and is steadily taking us away from the heart of the vortex.

units.rawText: (Gasps)
units.displayText: Gasps

spans.text: Gasps

units.rawText: Hang on to this!
units.displayText: Hang on to this!

spans.text: Hang on to this!

units.rawText: After leaving the water's surface for a moment, Sol pushes me toward something. I instinctively grab it before even registering it as a stout tree trunk.
units.displayText: After leaving the water's surface for a moment, Sol pushes me toward something. I instinctively grab it before even registering it as a stout tree trunk.

spans.text: After leaving the water's surface for a moment, Sol pushes me toward something. I instinctively grab it before even registering it as a stout tree trunk.

units.rawText: Professor! Are you alright!?
units.displayText: Professor! Are you alright!?

spans.text: Professor! Are you alright!?

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily) I'm fine...
units.displayText: (Coughs heavily) I'm fine...

spans.text: (Coughs heavily) I'm fine...

units.rawText: I glance over at Persicaria and Antonina, who are also staying afloat by hanging on to this tree trunk. Persicaria grabs my hand and I can feel the cold in her palm.
units.displayText: I glance over at Persicaria and Antonina, who are also staying afloat by hanging on to this tree trunk. Persicaria grabs my hand and I can feel the cold in her palm.

spans.text: I glance over at Persicaria and Antonina, who are also staying afloat by hanging on to this tree trunk. Persicaria grabs my hand and I can feel the cold in her palm.

units.rawText: This is bad... This tree trunk can't take our combined weight!
units.displayText: This is bad... This tree trunk can't take our combined weight!

spans.text: This is bad... This tree trunk can't take our combined weight!

units.rawText: All we can do is...
units.displayText: All we can do is...

spans.text: All we can do is...

units.rawText: Sol suddenly lets go of her grip on us, and Antonina immediately grabs her.
units.displayText: Sol suddenly lets go of her grip on us, and Antonina immediately grabs her.

spans.text: Sol suddenly lets go of her grip on us, and Antonina immediately grabs her.

units.rawText: What the hell are you doing!?
units.displayText: What the hell are you doing!?

spans.text: What the hell are you doing!?

units.rawText: Relax. I'm much better at floating than this big old log. I'll be fine!
units.displayText: Relax. I'm much better at floating than this big old log. I'll be fine!

spans.text: Relax. I'm much better at floating than this big old log. I'll be fine!

units.rawText: No, it's too dangerous! There's got to be another way!
units.displayText: No, it's too dangerous! There's got to be another way!

spans.text: No, it's too dangerous! There's got to be another way!

units.rawText: Just as it looks like we're stuck between a rock and a hard place, help comes from an unexpected quarter—
units.displayText: Just as it looks like we're stuck between a rock and a hard place, help comes from an unexpected quarter—

spans.text: Just as it looks like we're stuck between a rock and a hard place, help comes from an unexpected quarter—

units.rawText: Grab on!
units.displayText: Grab on!

spans.text: Grab on!

units.rawText: An unfamiliar voice calls out to us from the distance. Immediately after that, some kind of rope-like object swiftly and precisely coils around my waist.
units.displayText: An unfamiliar voice calls out to us from the distance. Immediately after that, some kind of rope-like object swiftly and precisely coils around my waist.

spans.text: An unfamiliar voice calls out to us from the distance. Immediately after that, some kind of rope-like object swiftly and precisely coils around my waist.

units.rawText: I reach down to touch it; it feels smooth and slippery, like rubber. However, it doesn't feel like an inanimate object; it even quivers when I make contact, like some kind of sensitive animal.
units.displayText: I reach down to touch it; it feels smooth and slippery, like rubber. However, it doesn't feel like an inanimate object; it even quivers when I make contact, like some kind of sensitive animal.

spans.text: I reach down to touch it; it feels smooth and slippery, like rubber. However, it doesn't feel like an inanimate object; it even quivers when I make contact, like some kind of sensitive animal.

units.rawText: This is...
units.displayText: This is...

spans.text: This is...

units.rawText: When I look up again, I find that the others have similar ropes wrapped around their waists.
units.displayText: When I look up again, I find that the others have similar ropes wrapped around their waists.

spans.text: When I look up again, I find that the others have similar ropes wrapped around their waists.

units.rawText: How are you guys, are you okay?
units.displayText: How are you guys, are you okay?

spans.text: How are you guys, are you okay?

units.rawText: The same voice calls out to us again, and we follow it back towards its source on the shore. There is a green-haired agent standing on the beach, one hand holding onto a massive rock while the other is waving wildly to us.
units.displayText: The same voice calls out to us again, and we follow it back towards its source on the shore. There is a green-haired agent standing on the beach, one hand holding onto a massive rock while the other is waving wildly to us.

spans.text: The same voice calls out to us again, and we follow it back towards its source on the shore. There is a green-haired agent standing on the beach, one hand holding onto a massive rock while the other is waving wildly to us.

units.rawText: There is some distance between us and the spraying sea foam prevents me from getting a good look at her. However, I can still tell that she's dressed in a very peculiar way. She's not attired like the agents of Magrasea, but more like someone from the real world.
units.displayText: There is some distance between us and the spraying sea foam prevents me from getting a good look at her. However, I can still tell that she's dressed in a very peculiar way. She's not attired like the agents of Magrasea, but more like someone from the real world.

spans.text: There is some distance between us and the spraying sea foam prevents me from getting a good look at her. However, I can still tell that she's dressed in a very peculiar way. She's not attired like the agents of Magrasea, but more like someone from the real world.

units.rawText: The strange thing is... both of this agent's arms are occupied, so how is she controlling those ropes...?
units.displayText: The strange thing is... both of this agent's arms are occupied, so how is she controlling those ropes...?

spans.text: The strange thing is... both of this agent's arms are occupied, so how is she controlling those ropes...?

units.rawText: I... I can't hold on much longer!
units.displayText: I... I can't hold on much longer!

spans.text: I... I can't hold on much longer!

units.rawText: I'll try to pull you to shore! But there's only so much I can do on my own...
units.displayText: I'll try to pull you to shore! But there's only so much I can do on my own...

spans.text: I'll try to pull you to shore! But there's only so much I can do on my own...

units.rawText: That's enough! Thank you very much!
units.displayText: That's enough! Thank you very much!

spans.text: That's enough! Thank you very much!

units.rawText: Sol shouts toward the agent on the shore. Upon hearing Sol's response, the agent sighs in visible relief.
units.displayText: Sol shouts toward the agent on the shore. Upon hearing Sol's response, the agent sighs in visible relief.

spans.text: Sol shouts toward the agent on the shore. Upon hearing Sol's response, the agent sighs in visible relief.

units.rawText: Prof, I can take you up to shore with this rope, but I can only bring one person with me at a time!
units.displayText: Prof, I can take you up to shore with this rope, but I can only bring one person with me at a time!

spans.text: Prof, I can take you up to shore with this rope, but I can only bring one person with me at a time!

units.rawText: Maybe you should go with me first...
units.displayText: Maybe you should go with me first...

spans.text: Maybe you should go with me first...

units.rawText: Take Persicaria first. I can still hang in there.
units.displayText: Take Persicaria first. I can still hang in there.

spans.text: Take Persicaria first. I can still hang in there.

units.rawText: No, Professor, you...
units.displayText: No, Professor, you...

spans.text: No, Professor, you...

options.rawText: Your temperature control systems can't maintain your normal body temperature anymore. Now isn't the time for us to be giving way to each other.
options.displayText: Your temperature control systems can't maintain your normal body temperature anymore. Now isn't the time for us to be giving way to each other.

spans.text: Your temperature control systems can't maintain your normal body temperature anymore. Now isn't the time for us to be giving way to each other.

options.rawText: Don't worry about me. We're just going in order. We're all going to make it.
options.displayText: Don't worry about me. We're just going in order. We're all going to make it.

spans.text: Don't worry about me. We're just going in order. We're all going to make it.

units.rawText: ...You're right. Please hang on!
units.displayText: ...You're right. Please hang on!

spans.text: ...You're right. Please hang on!

units.rawText: ...PLEASE hang in there! We'll meet up on the shore.
units.displayText: ...PLEASE hang in there! We'll meet up on the shore.

spans.text: ...PLEASE hang in there! We'll meet up on the shore.

units.rawText: Trust me.
units.displayText: Trust me.

spans.text: Trust me.

units.rawText: Prof, I'll leave Anna to you.
units.displayText: Prof, I'll leave Anna to you.

spans.text: Prof, I'll leave Anna to you.

units.rawText: No problem.
units.displayText: No problem.

spans.text: No problem.

units.rawText: Sol shifts Persicaria's weight to herself, then has Antonina take the freed-up space on the trunk.
units.displayText: Sol shifts Persicaria's weight to herself, then has Antonina take the freed-up space on the trunk.

spans.text: Sol shifts Persicaria's weight to herself, then has Antonina take the freed-up space on the trunk.

units.rawText: Anna, stick with the Prof, we'll come to get you once we get to shore!
units.displayText: Anna, stick with the Prof, we'll come to get you once we get to shore!

spans.text: Anna, stick with the Prof, we'll come to get you once we get to shore!

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: Assured that everything is in order, Sol finally lets go and shouts to the agent on the shore.
units.displayText: Assured that everything is in order, Sol finally lets go and shouts to the agent on the shore.

spans.text: Assured that everything is in order, Sol finally lets go and shouts to the agent on the shore.

units.rawText: We're climbing up the rope! Please hold on tight!
units.displayText: We're climbing up the rope! Please hold on tight!

spans.text: We're climbing up the rope! Please hold on tight!

units.rawText: Leave it to me!
units.displayText: Leave it to me!

spans.text: Leave it to me!

units.rawText: Holding on to the rope with one hand and to Persicaria with the other, Sol climbs toward the shore.
units.displayText: Holding on to the rope with one hand and to Persicaria with the other, Sol climbs toward the shore.

spans.text: Holding on to the rope with one hand and to Persicaria with the other, Sol climbs toward the shore.

units.rawText: The wind and waves slowly die down, and after making sure that the two of them won't be in danger on the way back, I take hold of Antonina, who's bobbing up and down on the water's surface in time with the currents.
units.displayText: The wind and waves slowly die down, and after making sure that the two of them won't be in danger on the way back, I take hold of Antonina, who's bobbing up and down on the water's surface in time with the currents.

spans.text: The wind and waves slowly die down, and after making sure that the two of them won't be in danger on the way back, I take hold of Antonina, who's bobbing up and down on the water's surface in time with the currents.

units.rawText: Hold on to me, Antonina. This way you won't be tossed around so much.
units.displayText: Hold on to me, Antonina. This way you won't be tossed around so much.

spans.text: Hold on to me, Antonina. This way you won't be tossed around so much.

units.rawText: ...Wait, let go of me!
units.displayText: ...Wait, let go of me!

spans.text: ...Wait, let go of me!

units.rawText: The intensity of Antonina's reaction exceeds my expectations and I hastily release her.
units.displayText: The intensity of Antonina's reaction exceeds my expectations and I hastily release her.

spans.text: The intensity of Antonina's reaction exceeds my expectations and I hastily release her.

units.rawText: Er... I just thought it would be safer this way...
units.displayText: Er... I just thought it would be safer this way...

spans.text: Er... I just thought it would be safer this way...

units.rawText: No, that's not what I meant! I've connected to Odile's signal!
units.displayText: No, that's not what I meant! I've connected to Odile's signal!

spans.text: No, that's not what I meant! I've connected to Odile's signal!

units.rawText: Antonina struggles to bring up a glowing green screen in mid-air, her eyes focused on the constantly changing readings and curves.
units.displayText: Antonina struggles to bring up a glowing green screen in mid-air, her eyes focused on the constantly changing readings and curves.

units.rawText: She's under the bedrock in the center of that vortex!
units.displayText: She's under the bedrock in the center of that vortex!

spans.text: She's under the bedrock in the center of that vortex!

units.rawText: I look toward the maelstrom's center as Antonina indicates. As the waves grow weaker, the fissure in the rocks begins to close up. Through it, I can vaguely see purple liquid churning within.
units.displayText: I look toward the maelstrom's center as Antonina indicates. As the waves grow weaker, the fissure in the rocks begins to close up. Through it, I can vaguely see purple liquid churning within.

units.rawText: Help me thank Sol when you get to shore, Professor.
units.displayText: Help me thank Sol when you get to shore, Professor.

spans.text: Help me thank Sol when you get to shore, Professor.

units.rawText: Antonina? What are you—
units.displayText: Antonina? What are you—

spans.text: Antonina? What are you—

units.displayText: Antonina suddenly pulls off the rope wrapped around the waist. The green-haired agent on the shore exclaims in surprise from afar.

spans.text: Antonina suddenly pulls off the rope wrapped around the waist. The green-haired agent on the shore exclaims in surprise from afar.

The force of the vortex has greatly lessened. The swimming skills that I still remember from my training are enough for me to control the direction of my forward movement.

units.rawText: Professor! What happened!? Did Antonina get sucked in?

spans.text: Professor! What happened!? Did Antonina get sucked in?

units.rawText: No, she swam there of her own will. She found Odile's signal down there.
units.displayText: No, she swam there of her own will. She found Odile's signal down there.

units.rawText: No... She's being too reckless!
units.displayText: No... She's being too reckless!

spans.text: No... She's being too reckless!

units.rawText: Oh yes, I think so too. But I also know that Antonina's not the sort of person who does reckless things for no reason.

units.rawText: By that, you mean...
units.displayText: By that, you mean...

spans.text: By that, you mean...

units.rawText: Two people have better odds than one, and they won't risk as much as four.
units.displayText: Two people have better odds than one, and they won't risk as much as four.

spans.text: Two people have better odds than one, and they won't risk as much as four.

units.rawText: You're going down there with Antonina!? No, it's too dangerous!
units.displayText: You're going down there with Antonina!? No, it's too dangerous!

spans.text: You're going down there with Antonina!? No, it's too dangerous!

units.rawText: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Besides, you'll be up here, won't you?
units.displayText: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Besides, you'll be up here, won't you?

spans.text: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Besides, you'll be up here, won't you?

units.rawText: You and Sol should find the Sector Administrator. There's no way an ecological researcher won't know about such a large cave under the sea.
units.displayText: You and Sol should find the Sector Administrator. There's no way an ecological researcher won't know about such a large cave under the sea.

spans.text: You and Sol should find the Sector Administrator. There's no way an ecological researcher won't know about such a large cave under the sea.

units.rawText: The administrator might know how to open the rock stratum. As long as you can do it again, we won't be completely separated.
units.displayText: The administrator might know how to open the rock stratum. As long as you can do it again, we won't be completely separated.

spans.text: The administrator might know how to open the rock stratum. As long as you can do it again, we won't be completely separated.

units.rawText: ...Alright then, I understand!
units.displayText: ...Alright then, I understand!

spans.text: ...Alright then, I understand!

units.rawText: At this point, all I can do is trust your judgment.
units.displayText: At this point, all I can do is trust your judgment.

units.rawText: Please stay safe, Professor! Contact me immediately once you find Antonina...

units.rawText: Don't worry, I will.
units.displayText: Don't worry, I will.

units.rawText: As I hang up, the cave that's about to close comes within arm's reach.
units.displayText: As I hang up, the cave that's about to close comes within arm's reach.

spans.text: As I hang up, the cave that's about to close comes within arm's reach.

units.rawText: I keep my eyes focused on that black entrance and hurl myself inside without looking back.
units.displayText: I keep my eyes focused on that black entrance and hurl myself inside without looking back.
